run_interoperability_test: run the gRPC interoperability test client against a server with a specified test case
create_stub_with_oauth: create a gRPC stub with OAuth2 access token credentials for the oauth2_auth_token test case
create_stub_with_compute_engine: create a gRPC stub with compute engine credentials for the compute_engine_creds test case
create_stub_with_jwt: create a gRPC stub with JWT token credentials from a service account file
run_secure_channel_test: run a gRPC interoperability test over a secure TLS channel with optional test CA certificates
